titulo: El de, la de, los de, las de = the one(s) with / from / of
subtitulo: El de la derecha. La de flores amarillas.
regla: Article + de picks out which one you mean without repeating the noun: Me gusta la de flores amarillas = the one with yellow flowers. The article agrees with the noun it replaces. Don't add another preposition after de.

bloques.texto: The article replaces a noun already known: **la (camisa) de rayas**.
It agrees in gender and number with that noun.
**De** covers _with, from, of, in, on_: **el de la derecha** = _the one on the right_; **los de segundo** = _the ones in second year_.
Never stack prepositions: ~~la de con flores~~.

lista.es: Mira esos cuadros. ==El de la derecha== está espectacular.
lista.en: Look at those paintings. The one on the right is spectacular.

lista.es: Todas están bonitas, pero ==la de flores amarillas== me encanta.
lista.en: They're all pretty, but I love the one with yellow flowers.

lista.es: Mis alumnos son buenos, pero ==los de segundo== son geniales.
lista.en: My students are good, but the second-year ones are great.

lista.es: Las pláticas de hoy estuvieron bien, pero ==las de ayer== fueron más útiles.
lista.en: Today's talks were fine, but yesterday's were more useful.
—Which taco do you want? —The al pastor one.

lista.texto: [[6074|el que, la que]] for _the one who / that_.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I prefer the blue car to the one from my brother._
lista.r: Prefiero el carro azul al de mi hermano.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Which glasses? The ones on the table._
Fix it: _Quiero la uno de chocolate._
